Bottom line: Securing the CoinEx Blockchain Lab at CUTM is not a typical campus event sponsorship. It is a permanent, branded institutional partnership inside one of Odisha's most recognised, nationally ranked, government-accredited universities — with state-wide reach across 6 campuses and a direct pipeline to thousands of future-ready students every year.
At a glance
CoinEx Blockchain Lab officially inaugurated at CUTM — Odisha's first dedicated blockchain innovation hub, permanently branded as CoinEx.
MoU officially signed between Santhosh Kumar (CoinEx) and Dr. Swarna Prabha Jena (Associate Dean, CUTM) inside the newly inaugurated laboratory.
Lab operates on 24/7 accessibility — open to students, developers, startups, and blockchain communities across Odisha, not just CUTM.
2 Campus Ambassadors officially onboarded — delivering on the commitment made at the June 22 Faculty Development Program.
Community network: Campus to Crypto · Odisha DAO · GDAI · Martians · Ferrus DAO activated at launch.
Post-event amplification: CoinEdition article + 2 CoinEx Instagram posts + 2 creator-led reels from influencers with 66K and 27K followers.

Regional context
The 2-year arc that led here
CoinEx was the first Web3 company to enter Bhubaneswar — and at entry, founded Odisha DAO, the first regional Web3 community in the state, which continues to serve as the regional anchor. The July 23 inauguration is the third and most consequential step in a deliberate multi-year strategy:
2024Market entry → Founded Odisha DAO — first Web3 community in Odisha
Jun 22Faculty Development Program at CUTM → Lab partnership terms secured, MoU framework agreed
Jul 23CoinEx Blockchain Lab inaugurated → MoU officially signed → Ambassadors onboarded → Permanent infrastructure live
Strategic milestone
MoU — officially signed & executed
📝
Memorandum of Understanding
Signed inside the CoinEx Blockchain Lab · 23 July 2026 · Bhubaneswar, Odisha
The symbolic choice to sign the MoU inside the lab itself — rather than in a boardroom or auditorium — reinforced the physicality and permanence of the partnership. The June 22 report flagged partnership formalization as a 30-day follow-up. That follow-up is now closed.

Strategic insights
What this milestone means

The lab is not a university facility — it is the launch of a permanent blockchain ecosystem hub for the entire state of Odisha, branded as CoinEx

MoU executed closes the June 22 follow-up: the partnership is now documented, formal, and operational with signed legal terms

24/7 access converts the lab from an event venue to always-on infrastructure — every session compounds CoinEx brand presence at zero incremental cost

Open to all Odisha — not just CUTM students. One branded physical asset serves a multi-campus, multi-community regional audience

2 Campus Ambassadors close another June 22 commitment — CoinEx shifts from episodic engagement to continuous, permanent on-campus presence

End-to-end arc: market entry → Odisha DAO → Faculty Program → permanent lab with MoU — now the reference template for CoinEx India's flagship university strategy

Flagged for HQ · escalation
Operational constraint
⚠️
Exchange app store availability — now a lab-scale issue. CoinEx Wallet is available on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. The CoinEx Exchange app is not. With the lab now operational and onboarding students at scale through continuous workshops, hackathons, and programming, this is no longer an event-day inconvenience — it is a structural blocker to the lab's core onboarding mission. Resolving exchange app store availability is a lab-scale priority, not just event-scale.
